// note: Standard NestJS build/test split (what `nest new` scaffolds): nest build AND `nest start --watch` compile the APP only, excluding test files — those are compiled by jest (jest.config.js). nest-cli.json points here; tsconfig.json stays spec-inclusive for the IDE / `tsc --noEmit`. Without this, nest --watch pulls every *.spec.ts into the app program, which blocks the dev server on test-only type errors.
